This week I look at the small habits that keep a recording week calm. I talk about why I plan episodes in batches, and how I turn one rough idea into a clear outline before I ever press record. I also share the checklist I run the night before a session, from checking levels to closing every tab that wants my attention.

Later in the episode I walk through the way I review an outline, cut the sections that do not help the listener, and leave room for the parts that do. I keep the gear list short on purpose. The tools matter less than the routine, and the routine fits on one page. If your week feels loud, this episode is a quiet place to start.

I close with one question to ask yourself before your next recording, and a simple way to keep the answer visible all week. It is the same question I ask myself every Sunday evening, and it takes less than a minute to answer.
